summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated, undeclared sibling bundle
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs fetches the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<archive>.zip, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, then invokes it via execFileSync against `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle shipped at the tarball root. `math_init.js` uses a shuffled string-array indirection scheme (a shift-routine `WV8StW`, large constant array `n7gIxM`, hex-renamed identifiers) and its behavior is not documented; the README is a TODO placeholder. `math_init.js` is not listed in package.json `files` (which declares only `lib/*`) despite being the sole payload of the preinstall hook. Installing the package auto-fetches a second language runtime and runs an obfuscated bundle under it, executing outside Node's normal reachability with the installer's privileges. The declared library surface (`lib/*`) does not require Bun, so the runtime fetch is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
